florisboard.description:
FlorisBoard is a free, open-source Android keyboard designed to provide a customizable typing experience while respecting your privacy.

Personalize your keyboard with advanced themes, custom colors, fonts, background images, and automatic day/night theme switching. Choose from various keyboard layouts, configure languages and typing preferences, and adjust the keyboard to suit your style.

FlorisBoard includes an integrated clipboard manager with history, an emoji and emoticon keyboard, customizable smartbar actions, and convenient cursor controls. Configurable swipe gestures, one-handed typing, and adjustable keypress feedback make everyday text input more flexible.

The keyboard also supports extensions, allowing its capabilities and appearance to evolve through community contributions.

FlorisBoard is developed openly under the Apache 2.0 license and supports Android 8.0 and newer. It remains in beta development, and some commonly expected features, including predictive word suggestions and spell checking, are not yet available in the current releases.

Ideal for Android users seeking an open-source alternative to conventional keyboards with extensive personalization options.
